author: Claude (L54b2 session) for roberto.carmeli@gmail.com
changes: Generated by models/comparator/genera_tlv1701.py from the frozen vendor file, nothing edited by hand, every patch counted against the vendor file: (1) CRLF -> LF; (2) the 16 'TC=0,0' removed (positional tempco, all 0); (3) the 5 '.MODEL VSWITCH' and their 'S_' instances rewritten as XSPICE aswitch with the same Voff/Von/Roff/Ron (smooth, either order, as PSpice); (4) the 23 IF(c,a,b) rewritten as ternaries; (5) the 5 '&' and 3 '|' as '&&' / '||'; (6) '2.5V' in IS_SET as 2.5. The subcircuit TLV1701 is then TI's model. (7) A second subcircuit, TLV1701_OC, is a NAMED variant, not TI's: (a) the input-range check no longer floats the output (SBOS589D 8.3.1, fig. 18: no phase inversion beyond the rails); (b) no mid-supply drive (an open-collector output cannot source current); (c) the supply window (a hard IF at 2.19 V) replaced by a smooth output conductance, 1 S above ~2.1 V and ~0 below ~1.9 V, as the bench's CMPOD; (d) the 55 uA only with > ~1 V of supply, as CMPOD (limitations #73); (e) the input decision a tanh 0.1 mV wide instead of a step. Two header comment lines added.
reason: L54b2: the comparators of ADR-102's timer (U513-U515 TLV1704, U505/U506/U508 TLV1702) with the manufacturer's model on the power-supply bench, against the behavioural CMPOD, on the safety cases. L41a's verdict on this file (DO NOT USE: the output at ~6 V, mid supply) had a cause: its VSWITCH translation (VT=(Von+Voff)/2, VH=(Von-Voff)/2) gives ngspice's SW a hysteresis as wide as the control swing and, for the four switches with Von < Voff, does not invert them (docs/preamp/data/2026-10-28/L54b2/prova/tb_sw.cir; limitations #77). TLV1701_OC exists because the faithful model cannot be taken through 2.19 V of supply in ngspice (it stops there, 1.4 GB and growing, prova/tb_tlv1701_rampa.cir), nor through a slowly moving input on the bench (Timestep too small in HPA_COMPHYS at 42.8 ms).
notes: Known cases (validate_models.py tb_tlv1701, both subcircuits, 5 V behind 1 ohm, 10k pull-up, IN- 1.25 V): threshold at the model's 0.4 mV offset both ways (VOS +-0.3 typ / +-2.5 max), tpLH ~584 ns / tpHL ~466 ns at 100 mV overdrive (SBOS589D 560 / 460 typ), VOL 75 mV at 0.5 mA (150 ohm), Iq 55 uA; TLV1701_OC through a V5 rising from 0 in wired-OR. The faithful TLV1701 run on ngbehavior=psa with the untouched vendor file gives the same thresholds and delays as this derivative (prova/psa/). NOT modelled (here and in CMPOD): the input clamp diodes to the rails (SBOS589D abs. max., note 2), temperature. Any XSPICE device in a deck makes ngspice reduce trtol to 1 for the whole deck ('Reducing trtol to 1 for xspice A devices'): a deck with this model is not the same numerical deck as one without it.
